name: stayinsured-legacy
description: Windows 7 feasibility probe for a parallel Electron edition of StayInsured

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run ui:build && electron .
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run ui:build && electron-builder --win --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run ui:build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
